function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command in the sandbox. Each call starts a fresh shell in /work; files persist between calls, shell variables and the working directory do not. A call is capped at 60 seconds (timeout_s, 1 to 60, default 30) and a command still running at the cap is killed. To keep something running after the call returns, start it as a background job and redirect its output, for example `nohup cmd > file 2>&1 &`; otherwise the call can block until the cap.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the command is killed (1 to 60, default 30).
